description: Create and run events in your comethru workspace through a conversation. Build event drafts, configure tickets and registration, review changes and approve publication. Manage guests, communications, venues and operations using only the permissions you grant and your current workspace role. Sensitive actions require review and approval. Refunds and other money-moving operations require the comethru dashboard. Sign-in, payment-provider verification and some device tasks use secure browser or device screens.
